zh.title: 以色列接收美製SH-60F直升機 並重啟第193中隊
zh.summary: 以色列國防軍宣布重啟第193中隊，並接收二手美軍SH-60F海鷹海上直升機。首批三架稱為「Shalach」的直升機已運抵，第一架於7月29日接收。該批直升機將替代已退役的AS565豹式直升機，中隊將於帕爾馬希姆空軍基地恢復海上支援作業。
body: 以色列國防軍宣布已重新啟用第193中隊，並接收二手美軍SH-60F海鷹海上直升機。首批運抵的三架直升機在以色列軍中被命名為「Shalach」，其中第一架已於7月29日正式接收。
新型SH-60F直升機將用以替代已退役的Eurocopter AS565豹式直升機（以色列稱為「Atalef」）。第193中隊自2025年9月起暫時解散，重新啟用後將在帕爾馬希姆空軍基地恢復運作，擔任海上支援中隊。
此批直升機屬於美國剩餘國防物資計畫移交項目，總計核准移交八架SH-60F直升機。目前已有三架完成交付，預計今年底前將再有兩架抵達以色列。

en.title: Israel Reopens 193rd Squadron with Arrival of US SH-60F Seahawks
en.summary: The Israel Defense Forces has reopened its 193rd Squadron following the arrival of former US Navy SH-60F Seahawk maritime helicopters. The first three aircraft, designated "Shalach" in Israeli service, have arrived, with the first received on July 29. The SH-60F fleet replaces the retired Eurocopter AS565 Panther helicopters to restore dedicated maritime aviation capabilities. The squadron will operate from Palmachim Airbase as a maritime support unit after being temporarily disbanded in September 2025.
body: The Israel Defense Forces has reopened its 193rd Squadron following the arrival of former US Navy SH-60F Seahawk maritime helicopters. The first three second-hand aircraft, designated "Shalach" in Israeli service, have been delivered, with the initial helicopter received on July 29.

The newly delivered SH-60F Seahawks replace the retired Eurocopter AS565 Panther helicopters, which were known in Israeli service as "Atalef." The 193rd Squadron will resume operations as a maritime support squadron based at Palmachim Airbase after being temporarily disbanded since September 2025.

The helicopters are being transferred under the United States Excess Defense Articles program, which approved a total of eight surplus SH-60F airframes for Israel. With three aircraft now delivered, two additional helicopters are scheduled to arrive by the end of the year.
